status_semantics: A task is VERIFIED only once its CI has actually been read and passed. NEX-090 is VERIFIED: four completed/success check-runs were read on docs head ea0a696, and the product diff between it and the product commit aa4b2c8 is empty, so the green runs tested the identical tree. Recording VERIFIED without reading a verdict would be the exact substitution NEX-090 exists to fix - a plausible stand-in for the exact value. A run superseded in the concurrency group reads completed/cancelled - never a failure, never evidence; and a commit superseded before any check-run reported has no check-runs at all, which is not a verdict either. Recurring quirk: pushing product and docs as separate commits on one branch supersedes the product commit's own runs, so the verdict is taken from the docs head and licensed by the empty product diff.

decisions_this_run: meta.total is a COUNT over the same agent-scoped set as the page, not len(items). The count is scoped by agent_id because an unscoped count discloses another agent's volume - the leak NEX-088's mutation check found in this same shape of code.

resumable_only is exempt from paging. It is the recovery set, so a window would silently abandon runs. Its meta describes the set actually returned rather than echoing a limit the request did not apply.
limit is bounded ge=1, le=200 so a caller cannot reopen the unbounded read by asking.
list_for_agent orders by (created_at DESC, id DESC) so offset paging cannot duplicate or skip a row when created_at ties.
